ApplyForStreamAccessToken.description_en: Obtain the Connection information for stream invocation
ApplyForStreamAccessToken.description_zh: 获取流式调用的连接信息

Associate.description_en: Suggests FAQs from the knowledge base based on a user's utterance
Associate.description_zh: 根据用户query联想知识库中的FAQ

BeginSession.description_en: Initiates a session and retrieves a welcome message

CancelChat.description_en: Cancels or interrupts an ongoing chat

CancelInstancePublishTask.description_en: Cancels a publishing task for a chatbot
CancelInstancePublishTask.description_zh: 在发布机器人的过程中，取消机器人发布任务

CancelPublishTask.description_en: Cancels a publish task that is in progress
CancelPublishTask.description_zh: 取消正在发布中的任务

Chat.description_en: Starts a conversation with a bot by specifying its Bot ID. This applies only to Chatbot (Legacy)
Chat.description_zh: 根据机器人唯一标识（机器人ID）与其进行会话，仅适用于智能对话机器人（旧版）

ContinueInstancePublishTask.description_en: Ignores an alarm and continues a chatbot publish task
ContinueInstancePublishTask.description_zh: 机器人发布告警时，忽略告警并继续发布

CreateConnQuestion.description_en: Creates a connected question for a knowledge item

CreateDSEntity.description_en: Creates an `entity` and its metadata, such as the `entity name` and `entity type`
CreateDSEntity.description_zh: 创建实体，特指实体的Meta信息，如：实体名称、实体类型

CreateDSEntityValue.description_en: Adds an entity member to a specified entity. An entity member includes an entity value and a synonym list. All entity values and synonyms must be unique within the same entity
CreateDSEntityValue.description_zh: 为指定的某个实体，添加实体成员信息，包含：实体值、对应的同义词列表，同一实体内部的实体值、同义词唯一

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates a robot in the sandbox environment

CreateInstancePublishTask.description_en: Publishes a sandbox robot to the production environment
CreateInstancePublishTask.description_zh: 将沙箱机器人发布到线上

CreateIntent.description_en: Creates an intent. This operation defines an intent's metadata, such as its name, alias, and associated slots. It does not include utterances or LGF
CreateIntent.description_zh: 新建意图，主要包含意图的meta信息，如：意图名称、意图别名、意图关联词槽信息；不包含意图话术、LGF

CreateLgf.description_en: Creates an advanced semantic configuration (LGF) for a specified intent
CreateLgf.description_zh: 为指定意图创建高级语义配置（LGF）

CreatePublishTask.description_en: Creates a publish task in the publishing center
CreatePublishTask.description_zh: 创建发布中心的发布任务

CreateUserSay.description_en: Adds a user say to a specified intent
CreateUserSay.description_zh: 为指定意图添加话术的信息

DeleteCategory.description_en: Deletes a category. A published category is marked as deleted and unpublished, while an unpublished category is deleted permanently
DeleteCategory.description_zh: 删除类目， 已发布的类目变成已删除未发布状态，未发布的类目则直接删除

DeleteDSEntity.description_en: Deletes an entity. This operation also cascade-deletes all associated entity members, synonyms, and regular expressions
DeleteDSEntity.description_zh: 删除一个实体，会级联删除该实体下所有的实体成员及同义词、正则表达式

DeleteDSEntityValue.description_en: Deletes a specific entity value from an entity. If the entity is a standard entity, its synonyms (if any) are also deleted
DeleteDSEntityValue.description_zh: 删除某个实体的某个成员；若为标准实体，会同步删除其同义词（若有）

DeleteInstance.description_en: Deletes an instance from the sandbox and online environments
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 删除沙箱和线上的机器人

DeleteIntent.description_en: Deletes a specified intent and its associated user utterances and advanced semantic configurations (LGF)
DeleteIntent.description_zh: 删除一个意图，会级联删除该意图下所有的意图话术和高级语义配置（LGF）

DeleteLgf.description_zh: 删除指定高级语义配置

DeleteUserSay.description_en: Deletes a user say from a specified intent

DescribeCategory.description_en: Gets information about a specific category

DescribeDSEntity.description_en: Retrieves metadata for a specified entity associated with a robot, such as the entity type, entity name, creation time, and modification time
DescribeDSEntity.description_zh: 查询指定机器人下指定实体的meta信息，如：实体类型、实体名称、创建时间、修改时间等

DescribeInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a robot

DescribeIntent.description_en: Returns metadata for a specified intent, including its type, name, creation time, and modification time
DescribeIntent.description_zh: 返回指定意图的 meta 信息，如：意图类型、意图名称、创建时间、修改时间等

DescribePerspective.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified perspective

Feedback.description_en: Saves user feedback on chatbot responses
Feedback.description_zh: 保存用户对于问答结果的评价

GenerateUserAccessToken.description_en: Generates a user access token to enable single sign-on for a chat window. The token associates the user with their corporate identity
GenerateUserAccessToken.description_zh: 用于聊天窗用户免登时，获取Token，通过该Token可将用户的企业身份带入

GetAgentInfo.description_en: Retrieves details for a specified agent

GetAsyncResult.description_en: Retrieves the execution result of an asynchronous service. This API is used in conjunction with the Chat API
GetAsyncResult.description_zh: 获取异步服务执行结果，配合Chat接口使用

GetBotSessionData.description_en: Retrieves overview metrics for a bot
GetBotSessionData.description_zh: 查询机器⼈问答概览指标

GetInstancePublishTaskState.description_en: Checks the status of a bot publishing task

GetPublishTaskState.description_en: Gets the progress of a publish task

InitIMConnect.description_en: Initializes the Instant Messaging (IM) connection using the `From` value configured in the channel console. This operation lets you pass a user authentication token during initialization
InitIMConnect.description_zh: 通过渠道后台配置生成的from值，自定义初始化im连接信息，初始化时支持传递用户鉴权token

LinkInstanceCategory.description_en: Links knowledge categories to a chatbot

ListAgent.description_en: Lists the business spaces for your Alibaba Cloud account
ListAgent.description_zh: 获取当前阿里云账号的业务空间列表

ListConnQuestion.description_en: Lists the connected questions for a knowledge item
ListConnQuestion.description_zh: 查询知识的关联问题列表

ListDSEntity.description_en: Lists the entities for a specified robot. This operation returns only entity metadata, such as the entity type, name, creation time, and update time
ListDSEntity.description_zh: 查询指定机器人下的实体列表数据，仅返回每个实体的meta信息，如：实体类型、实体名称、创建时间、修改时间等

ListDSEntityValue.description_en: Retrieves the list of entity values for a specified entity. You can filter by keyword using a `contains` match. The search covers both entity values and their synonyms
ListDSEntityValue.description_zh: 查询指定实体的实体成员列表及详情数据，同时支持关键词筛选（contains），筛选范围：实体值、同义词

ListIntent.description_en: Retrieves metadata for all intents in a specified bot, including the intent type, intent name, creation time, and modification time
ListIntent.description_zh: 查询指定机器人下的意图列表数据，仅返回每个意图的 meta 信息，如：意图类型、意图名称、创建时间、修改时间等

ListLgf.description_en: Queries the advanced semantic configurations (LGF) for a specified intent
ListLgf.description_zh: 查询指定意图的高级语义配置（LGF）

ListSaasPermissionGroupInfos.description_en: Lists the permission groups for integrated SaaS applications. Use these groups to grant permissions to users
ListSaasPermissionGroupInfos.description_zh: 获取权限被集成信息列表，可通过该列表返回的权限组，给用户授权

ListSimQuestion.description_en: Queries the list of similar questions for a knowledge entry
ListSimQuestion.description_zh: 查询知识的相似问题列表

ListSolution.description_en: Lists the solutions for a knowledge entry

ListTongyiConversationLogs.description_en: Retrieves the conversation logs for a single session of a Tongyi chatbot
ListTongyiConversationLogs.description_zh: 查询对话机器人通义版的单个会话对话记录

ListUserSay.description_en: Queries the user says and their associated slot information for a specified intent. You can filter the results by keywords
ListUserSay.description_zh: 查询指定意图的话术内容及关联槽位信息，支持关键话术筛选（contains）

Nlu.description_en: Returns the natural language understanding (NLU) results for a user query. Currently, this feature only supports NLU from Conversation Factory and Central Control. Support for other engines will be added as needed
Nlu.description_zh: 针对用户query，返回机器人有关这个query的语言理解（nlu）结果。当前只支持对话工厂、中控的NLU信息透出，其他引擎后续按需支持

TongyiChatDebugInfo.description_en: Debugging information for large language model Q&A

UpdateDSEntity.description_en: Updates the metadata of an entity. You can modify the entity name, but not the entity type
UpdateDSEntity.description_zh: 实体meta信息修改，仅支持修改实体名称；实体类型不支持修改

UpdateDSEntityValue.description_en: Modifies an entity value. This applies to entity values that use synonyms or regular expressions. Note: You cannot add a regular expression to a standard entity, and vice versa
UpdateDSEntityValue.description_zh: 修改某个实体的某个实体成员，有实体值&同义词、正则表达式两类数据修改。注意：往一个标准实体中添加正则表达式是不被允许的，反之亦然

UpdateInstance.description_en: Updates a chatbot's name and description

UpdateIntent.description_en: Updates the metadata of a specified intent, including the intent name, alias name, and associated slots. This operation does not modify the intent's utterances or LGF
UpdateIntent.description_zh: 修改意图，主要包含意图的meta信息，如：意图名称、意图别名、意图关联词槽信息；不包含意图话术、LGF

UpdateLgf.description_en: Updates the advanced semantic feature (LGF) for a specified intent
UpdateLgf.description_zh: 为指定意图创建高级语义配置（LGF）

UpdatePerspective.description_en: Updates a perspective's name and description
